## Review checklist

- [ ] Scope is focused and related issues are linked where applicable.
- [ ] Relevant checks pass; unavailable checks and limitations are stated.
- [ ] Behavior changes have appropriate regression coverage.
- [ ] Help, documentation, and changelog are updated where applicable.
- [ ] Distribution files are included in the package allowlist where applicable.
- [ ] No credentials, runtime data, generated archives, or node_modules are included.
- [ ] New dependencies and their licenses are explained, if any.
